purpose: Fail publication builds when known internal editorial labels, review cards, metadata or stored review advice leak into public HTML, search data or RSS.

policy.inventory: Existing public per-language search indexes; en/ko plus actually published translation languages.
checks: Known localized archive UI editorial labels and Korean editorial record formats.
Review cards including hidden cards on public article pages.
Stored reviewFocus text for each public digest URL.
Known review metadata fields in search records and feed items.
Missing or malformed indexes/articles/feeds, duplicate inventory URLs and output-directory traversal.
preserved: HTML code and source quotations, fenced Markdown code and Markdown quotations.
Actual technical corrections, follow-up facts, news dates and source links.
policy.scopeLimit: Known formats and stored advice only; not universal semantic or factual review in all languages.
policy.privateReviewShell: Excluded from public article inventory, remains noindex; not claimed to require authentication.
policy.errorOutput: File paths and rule identifiers only; no private review advice text.

validation.mockLeakDetection: HTML headings/cards, search body/metadata, RSS descriptions/content/metadata and unlabelled known advice rejected.

review.method: Self AI code review and regression tests; no independent or human review.
review.limit: Article text, UI templates and translation files unchanged. No claim about search-engine rankings or external caches.

publication: Draft review PR for the new guard only; no translation or article publication.
